newsitem.title: USA: GM names dealer network development head.
newsitem.headline: GM names dealer network development head.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Thursday John Spellen was named executive director of Dealer Network Development.
Spellen, whose appointment was effective April 1, succeeds Edd Roggenkamp III, who was recently promoted to general manager of Dealer Network Investment & Development, GM said.

In his new position, Spellen will have responsibility for the ongoing development and implementation of Project 2000, the GM dealer channeling strategy. Previous to this appointment, Spellen worked on the program since moving to the United States from GM of Canada in 1990.
